violations.text: The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - hot-hold unit - food processor base - flat top table - cold hold drawers under grill New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
The ceiling tiles in the basement area is in poor repair (previous water damage and missing tile). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The following areas need to be cleaned: - walls and floors around grill area (food debris) - ceiling/vents in kitchen area (dust debris) - caulking around 3 bay sink area (black debris) The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025

The chlorine concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was (0) parts per million (ppm). The concentration of chlorine in the sanitizing solution must be between 50-100 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was ( 0) parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for (chlorine ) sanitizer is (50-100) ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
(Sanitizer dispenser ) located in the (warewashing) area was not in good repair. PIC informed of proper manual sanitizing. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the (hood vents and prep table shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
